sources.source: Fire and rescue incident statistics, year ending March 2026
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_fact: The accredited release published 22 July 2026 reports 641,227 incidents attended, 170,597 fires and 254 fire-related fatalities in England. Incident collection moved from IRS to FaRDaP in November 2025, and Suffolk figures for part of 2024-25 are explicitly identified as an underestimate.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current fire-service demand and response context while retaining incident-versus-fire, fatality revision, platform-transition, local missingness, population-rate and response-time exclusion guards; fire-service-area data are not parcel measurements.

sources.source: Security Industry Authority annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The official report covers SIA performance and finances for 2024-25. A January 2026 correction replaced an erroneous figure of 440 approved-contractor improvement notices with 18, demonstrating a material published-data correction.
sources.quality_effect: Adds private-security licensing and regulatory context while retaining licence-versus-person, contractor-assurance, notice-versus-breach, correction-history and regulatory-activity-versus-public-safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: Gangmasters and Labour Abuse Authority: annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The accessible report states that the time to issue a new licence was reduced by 69% and that 121% more compliance inspections were initiated in 2024-25. It also records the planned transition of GLAA functions into the Fair Work Agency.
sources.quality_effect: Adds labour-exploitation regulatory context while retaining licence-versus-worker, inspection-versus-confirmed-abuse, percentage-baseline, organisational-transition and enforcement-outcome guards.

sources.source: National Crime Agency annual report and accounts: 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The official report contains NCA performance against its priorities, assessment of the serious and organised crime threat, governance and risk processes, and audited financial statements for 2024-25.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national organised-crime threat and agency-capability context while retaining intelligence-versus-recorded-crime, disruption-versus-conviction, national-versus-local scope, classified-detail and performance-output guards.

sources.source: HM Chief Inspector of Prisons annual report: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published 7 July 2026 draws on 84 inspection reports and independent reviews of progress covering prisons, young offender institutions, secure training centres, immigration detention, court custody and other custodial settings.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent custody-safety inspection context while retaining inspection-versus-establishment, announced-versus-unannounced visit, publication-period, thematic-report and finding-versus-population-prevalence guards.

sources.source: College of Policing Limited: annual report and accounts, 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The official report published 9 February 2026 covers the College's performance, strategy, accountability and financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds policing standards, evidence and leadership context while retaining programme-versus-force-delivery, guidance-versus-compliance, national-body-versus-local-force and activity-versus-crime-outcome guards.

sources.source: HMPPS Annual Report and Accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.authority: HM Prison and Probation Service and Ministry of Justice
sources.verified_fact: The HMPPS performance report covers prison, probation and youth-custody delivery, including security technology, safer recruitment, drug-testing services, staffing and rehabilitation activity during 2024-25.
sources.quality_effect: Adds system-capacity and public-protection context while retaining operational-activity-versus-outcome, prison-versus-probation, staffing, programme-stage, reporting-year and no-area-risk-score guards.

sources.source: HMPPS annual report on the IPP sentence 2025 to 26
sources.authority: HM Prison and Probation Service and Ministry of Justice
sources.verified_fact: The official HMPPS annual-reporting collection was updated 9 July 2026 with the 2025-26 IPP report. The series combines annual accountability with an action plan for safe release, licence management and cohort-data improvement.
sources.quality_effect: Adds indeterminate-sentence public-protection context while retaining cohort-versus-person, release-versus-licence-termination, recall-decision, action-plan-versus-delivered-outcome and collection-page guards.

sources.source: Prisons and Probation Ombudsman 2025 to 2026 annual report
sources.verified_fact: The report published 9 July 2026 covers the PPO's investigation of deaths in custody, deaths within 14 days of release except homicide, and complaints from prisoners, young people, probation-supervised people and immigration detainees.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent complaint and fatal-incident investigation context while retaining complaint-versus-substantiated-finding, death-jurisdiction, release-window, establishment and investigation-lag guards.

sources.source: Youth Justice Board Annual Report and Accounts, 2024 to 2025
sources.authority: Youth Justice Board for England and Wales
sources.verified_fact: The report describes YJB oversight of the youth justice system and its collection and analysis of first-time entrants, reoffending and use-of-custody data, alongside organisational delivery and accounts.
sources.quality_effect: Adds youth-justice oversight context while retaining child-versus-case, first-entry, reoffending cohort, custody-use, England-and-Wales scope and annual-report-versus-statistical-release guards.

sources.source: Charity Commission annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Charity Commission for England and Wales
sources.verified_fact: At 31 March 2026 the Commission reported 171,112 charities on the register and regulation of approximately £106.992 billion of charity income. It also described disinformation and hostile external threats affecting charities and community service delivery.
sources.quality_effect: Adds charity-governance and community-resilience context while retaining registered-versus-unregistered body, income-versus-service, threat-report-versus-incident, regulatory-case and national-sector guards.

sources.source: Ofsted corporate annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published 14 July 2026 covers Ofsted performance and finances. Ofsted separately reported 45 test visits and pilots before the November 2025 education framework launch and 1,420 state-funded school inspections afterwards, 1,380 of them full inspections.
sources.quality_effect: Adds education and children's-services inspection context while retaining pilot-versus-live, inspection-versus-provider, framework-change, report-card, sector and inspection-period guards.

sources.source: Equality and Human Rights Commission: annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report published 9 July 2026 documents EHRC performance, accountability and finances for the 2025-26 financial year.
sources.quality_effect: Adds equality-and-rights regulatory context while retaining inquiry-versus-finding, legal-power, advice-versus-enforcement, UK-jurisdiction and regulatory-output-versus-population-harm guards.

sources.source: OPG annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The Office of the Public Guardian's statutory annual report for 2025-26 was laid before Parliament on 15 July 2026 and covers the agency's service and financial performance in England and Wales.
sources.quality_effect: Adds vulnerable-adult protection and supervision context while retaining application-versus-person, registration-versus-supervision, investigation, service-timeliness and annual-report-versus-safeguarding-incidence guards.

sources.source: HM Land Registry Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 15 July 2026 report identifies protection of property rights through accurate registers, digital systems and resilient infrastructure, and includes a dedicated section on vigilance against property fraud.
sources.quality_effect: Adds property-fraud and register-integrity context while retaining application-versus-title, attempted-versus-prevented-fraud, restriction, registration-lag and service-performance-versus-local-crime guards.

sources.source: CMA Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published 9 July 2026 summarises CMA performance for 2025-26 and was published with an Impact Assessment and stakeholder-experience and business-perception survey reports.
sources.quality_effect: Adds consumer and market-protection governance context while retaining case-versus-market, intervention-versus-realised-impact, survey-perception, competition-versus-product-safety and national-economy guards.

sources.source: Care Quality Commission annual report and accounts 2024/2025
sources.verified_fact: CQC published the 2024-25 report on 21 May 2026, noting that publication was delayed by pension-assurance dependencies. Its performance overview also records that poorly performing IT systems hampered rollout of a new assessment framework and ways of working.
sources.quality_effect: Adds health-and-care regulator reliability context while retaining reporting-period lag, assessment-versus-provider-quality, IT-system constraint, registration, concern-response and inspection-output guards.

sources.source: HM Inspectorate of Probation Annual Report 2026
sources.verified_fact: The combined annual report published 20 July 2026 covers probation, youth justice, national and local-area inspections and describes an increasingly large and complex probation caseload amid systemic strain and continuous change.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent probation and youth-justice inspection context while retaining caseload-versus-person, inspection-versus-service, local-versus-national programme, complexity and finding-versus-public-safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: Independent Anti-Slavery Commissioner's annual report 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published 17 June 2026 accounts for the Commissioner's work against the Strategic Plan 2024-26 across prevention, detection, investigation, prosecution, victim support and research.
sources.quality_effect: Adds modern-slavery coordination and victim-protection context while retaining referral-versus-victim, objective-versus-outcome, enforcement, survivor-support, prevalence-estimation and UK-wide scope guards.

sources.source: CICA Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: The report published 14 July 2026 outlines CICA performance during the 2025-26 financial year across England, Scotland and Wales.
sources.quality_effect: Adds violent-crime victim-compensation administration context while retaining application-versus-victim, award-versus-offence, eligibility, decision timing, geography and compensation-volume-versus-crime-incidence guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Fire incident totals use a platform-transition snapshot, response-time exclusions, revisions and documented local undercount.
Regulatory annual reports describe activity, governance and finances rather than population harm prevalence.
Licences, inspections, notices, investigations and disruptions use distinct units and evidential thresholds.
Custody, probation and youth-justice inspection findings do not represent all establishments, people or incidents.
IPP action plans, release decisions, recalls and licence terminations are separate stages and outcomes.
Charity-sector scale, hostile threats and compliance activity cannot be downscaled to local-area risk.
Ofsted and CQC framework, inspection, assessment and reporting-system changes affect comparability.
Property-register applications, prevented fraud and recorded property crime are separate measures.
Modern-slavery referrals, identified victims, prosecutions and prevalence estimates are not interchangeable.
Compensation applications and awards do not measure the incidence or geography of violent crime.
The uploaded 046 note remains non-canonical without matching task, heartbeat, claim and receipt evidence.
No existing candidate score, endpoint manifest or stored parcel value was modified.
